title: Huawei Kirin 2026 9050 Pro said to have 238 Mtr/mm2
author: S
text:
F

Fred Chen
Moderator

Huawei Kirin 2026 is a new-generation smartphone chip launched by Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. in 2026. This chip is the world's first mass-produced smartphone chip featuring logic folding technology, adopting a dual-layer vertical stacking architecture and a "time scaling" solution. Its transistor density has increased by 53.5%, reaching 238 million transistors per square millimeter; the P-core energy efficiency has increased by 41%, and the maximum frequency has increased by 12.7%.

The chip has successfully completed tape-out and entered the testing and debugging phase. According to the plan, the Kirin 9050 Pro will officially debut in the autumn of 2026 and will be first adopted by the Huawei Mate 90 Series .
